transcript: Did you know that if you add chia seeds to Greek yogurt, drizzle in a little honey and coffee, mix it all together, then add another layer of yogurt on top and dust it with cocoa powder, pop it in the fridge for two hours, and you've got yourself a chia tiramisu that is one of the most powerful fat-burning snacks out there. The coffee activates thermogenesis, which is your body's ability to burn calories by generating heat, and the cocoa brings antioxidants and lifts your mood. Together, they create a dessert that tastes like a cheat meal but actually works in your favor. Have it as an afternoon snack or as a dinner substitute. It's light, nutritious, and kills those late night cravings. But I want you to understand something. You can eat the best snacks in the world. If on the inside you're still living in a state of stress, your body is going to keep holding on to fat. Stress releases cortisol, and cortisol tells your body to store fat no matter what you eat. Late night cravings aren't greed. They're a nervous system looking for calm through food. Snacking at odd hours isn't lack of willpower. It's anxiety disguised as hunger.
